## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [contributing guide](https://github.com/serbantasss/DocDateTrack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for every change in behaviour.
- [ ] I updated the documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`, `.env.example`) where needed.
- [ ] I added an entry to the `Unreleased` section of `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes.
- [ ] This pull request contains no secrets and no real personal data.
- [ ] For UI changes: I added screenshots, and the views use no inline scripts, inline styles, event-handler attributes or external assets.
